title: Donald Duck
blurb: Disney's famously short-tempered sailor duck, one of animation's most enduring stars since his debut in the 1930s.
facts: He typically wears a sailor shirt and cap with a bow tie.
Often described by critics and scholars as a global pop culture icon of animation, Donald is known for his semi-intelligible speech and his volatile, boisterous, and high-energy...
